title: What to do if you lose your passport while traveling abroad
desc: Get an emergency travel replacement quickly through official diplomatic channels.
todos: File a report with local police immediately and request a copy of the official police report for documentation.
Locate the nearest embassy or consulate for your home country and schedule an urgent emergency appointment.
Gather proof of citizenship (photo ID copy, birth certificate) and standard passport-sized photos.
Complete government form DS-64 (Statement Regarding Lost/Stolen Passport) and emergency issuance paperwork.
Pay the replacement fee and obtain an Emergency Limited-Validity Passport to complete your travel.
